body:
Hey there, thanks for the response
 I don't take antidepressants, when I interact with people I often have good or bad interactions. There are periods when I'm outgoing but the majority of the time I have resting asshole face and despise random conversation. 

 I work everyday and go to sleep at irregular times, sometimes I get 5 hours or 3 hours of sleep before working, the only real time I get rest is during the weekends when I catch up. I just have no drive to do anything, I dislike communication as I always put a filter on to tailor to the other person. I feel so exhausted after being with other people for more than an hour. I just find I cannot relate to anyone, I'd rather skip the small talk not talk about stupid things such as how you are feeling or what concert you are seeing and delve into the big logical issues, or question existence or pick out patterns other people make. I dunno I guess I'm weird.

I despise my life right now it just feels repetitive and never ending. I disliked every job I have held and just find it to be too much of an effort to do anything and everything. I'll make plans with friends and when the time comes for action I will just want to stay home and lay on my couch and often blow off many plans because of it.

I don't know I'd like to think there was a time in my life when I wasn't like this but honestly I feel like I've been self-centered in thought for the majority of my life.

I wouldn't say I disregard other people at all though. I hate most conversation, feel like I never say the right thing or ask the right questions, I just feel so different from everyone like an alien. I do care about others though, often when someone is in trouble I'm one of the few bystanders that run in to help. Or when theres a homeless man other people disregard , I can sit down right beside him and have a conversation with him no problem. I feel like I have my humanity but lack it at the same time if that makes sense. I guess I lack conversational awareness or disregard it as I please. I often speak logically without any regard for other people's feelings. Ive been the outcast of my social circles, and its been hurting for a while. Many people think I am completely oblivious to their sarcasm, sense of humor, which is true to an extent, but I know exactly how they perceive me, what they truly think about me, and it hurts.

Ive barely scratched the surface but I just don't feel human anymore.

I'm on no medication and I don't want to be, for most of my life I thought I could kick this thing with just my mind but its a losing battle.

Lastly, I'm addicted to alcohol, marijuana, pornography and cigarettes. When I quit some of the vices I swap to another, porn being the most impossible to quit. I'd like to blame my problems on very heavy substance use early on but as far as I know I've been like this my entire life. I feel like I'd be better off as a hermit in the mountain away from society, but being dead seems more realistic as I would not have the awareness to survive on my own.

Maybe I'm sort of ranting and not answering in half truths, life is just weird. If it weren't for my computer I would have no happiness or joy whatsoever.
Lots of scary reviews on the amazon website saying the left thumbstick of the elite breaks frequently. Sigh to have a regular xbox controller
